# Discussion Categories Configuration
#
# After enabling Discussions in repo settings, create these categories:
#
# 1. 📣 Announcements (read-only, maintainers only)
#    - Release announcements
#    - Important updates
#
# 2. 💡 Ideas
#    - Feature ideas and brainstorming
#    - Use cases not covered by current API
#
# 3. 🙋 Q&A
#    - How-to questions
#    - Integration help
#    - "Is this possible?" questions
#
# 4. 💬 General
#    - Show and tell (printed something cool?)
#    - Off-topic printing discussion
#
# 5. 📚 Show and Tell
#    - Share your PrintBridge integrations
#    - Custom label templates
#    - Web app integrations
